author: claude
summary: Task 006 of the voice-card-consolidation plan: simplifies VoiceCatalogCard.tsx's 8-item overflow menu down to a direct 'Set Default' card action plus a slim overflow (Rename/Export/Delete). Removed 'Open in Voice Lab' (redundant with the card body/CTA), 'Edit Metadata' (moved to VoiceLabPage Overview tab), 'Edit Recording Script' (Test tab), and 'Voice Settings' (Variants tab) -- all confirmed reachable there per tasks 002-005. Also resolves a flagged gap from task 005: VoicesPage's catalog flow still wired 'Edit Recording Script'/'Voice Settings' menu items to the old ScriptEditor/VoiceSettingsPanel drawers in VoicesModals.tsx; since those menu items no longer exist, the drawer wiring (and the editingProfile/testText/editSurface/etc. state and handleSaveTestText/handleResetTestText actions that only fed it) was dead and removed. ScriptEditor and VoiceSettingsPanel components themselves are untouched and still live via VoiceLabPage's TestTab/VariantsTab.

files.change: Overflow menu slimmed to Rename/Export/Delete; added a direct 'Set Default' button in the actions row; removed onEditTestText/onEditVoiceSettings props (onEditMetadata kept -- still drives the untagged-badge click).
Removed onEditTestText/onEditVoiceSettings props and their forwarding to VoiceCatalogCard.

Removed the onEditTestText/onEditVoiceSettings callbacks (previously set state.editingProfile/editSurface) and the editingVoiceMetadata memo/prop that only fed the now-removed drawers; stopped passing drawer-only props to VoicesModals.
Removed the ScriptEditor and VoiceSettingsPanel Drawer instances (unreachable once the catalog card menu items were removed) and the associated props from VoicesModalsProps.

Removed editingProfile/testText/variantName/editingEngine/referenceSample/engineVoiceId/editingSettings/editSurface/isSavingText state and its sync effect -- only consumer was the removed drawer wiring.
Removed handleSaveTestText/handleResetTestText (only caller was the removed VoicesModals drawers) and now-unused imports/destructures.
Added .voice-catalog-card__set-default-btn styling to match the existing preview/CTA button sizing, including the touch-target media query bump.

Removed assertions on the deleted menu items; added coverage for Set Default as a direct action (enabled/disabled state) and the slimmed 3-item overflow menu; kept an UntaggedBadge->onEditMetadata regression test.
Replaced onEditTestText/onEditVoiceSettings forwarding tests with coverage for the surviving Set Default/Rename/Export/onNavigateToLab forwarding.

Replaced the two ScriptEditor/VoiceSettingsPanel drawer-reachability tests with tests asserting those items (and Edit Metadata/Open in Voice Lab) are absent from the catalog card overflow menu, and that Set Default is directly reachable.
Deleted -- its sole subject (handleSaveTestText) was removed as dead code.
